layers.purpose: trace carriageway edges rather than road centre lines
trace railway alignment and structures relevant to orientation
store supported approximate event locations as areas
record deliberate readability/playability adaptations separately from historical geometry

rules: Historical geography and gameplay tuning must remain separate.
Source-geometry confidence and 1936 event-date confidence must be recorded separately.
Apparent gaps remain unknown until checked.
No essential route may depend on an unverified historic passage unless it is explicitly recorded as a fictional gameplay adaptation.
Approximate event locations must remain areas rather than false exact points.
Confidence applies to the individual feature claim, not to the prestige of the source.
